From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Pre-launch thresholds, canary plan, and doc ownership for Runtime v2 activation

Hi all,

Quick sync — we have the activation target for Runtime v2 tentatively slated for 2028-07-02. Before we lock the date I need alignment on the following pre-launch items so I can brief leadership and share a final mutual action plan with AcmeCloud this Friday: 

1) Canary plan: proposed initial traffic % and duration (ops requirement + rollback triggers).
2) Release gates: explicit pass/fail criteria (perf, error-rate, integration smoke).
3) Enablement deliverables: slide deck, one-pagers, training slots and owners.
4) Customer-specific exceptions: Acme requested a tighter data-residency note — do we need an exception?
5) Docs: who owns the runbook, API changes, and migration FAQ?

Attached are an initial prelaunch checklist and a canary matrix for reference (prelaunch-checklist.xlsx, canary-matrix.csv). Please reply by EOD 6/07 with owners, blockers, and any changes to the proposed gates. If any item needs leadership sign-off, flag it inline.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-launch thresholds, canary plan, and doc ownership for Runtime v2 activation

Thanks Karthik — quick thoughts from Enablement/CS lens: 

- Enablement deck needs two customer-facing scenarios (Acme-specific: batch migration + low-latency routing). I can draft the scenarios but need product confirmation on the recommended migration steps.
- Training: we have limited instructor capacity the last week of June. Proposed slot window: Jun 26-28 (half-day sessions). Can we confirm by 6/10 so CS can block calendars?
- Exceptions: if Acme wants a data-residency note, we should add a short FAQ and a line in the contract addendum; legal may need to weigh in.
- For release gates: we should explicitly call out a rollback window (30 minutes post-canary) and an ops contact list.

I'll volunteer to own the enablement slide deck and coordinate the training schedule, but I need a docs owner for the detailed migration FAQ.

Marissa

Ops/infra notes — I want to be explicit on a couple of operational gating items before we commit to 7/02: 

1) Canary sizing: propose 10% of traffic for 4 hours, with automated rollback if 5xxs spike > 0.5% or P99 latency regresses > 25% vs baseline. The canary-matrix.csv has a starting point but we should lock numbers now.
2) Capacity: if Acme expects higher TPS during migration windows we should reserve burst capacity — that requires a short procurement request (2-3 additional GPUs reserved) and timeline (need decision by 6/14).
3) Monitoring/alerts: add explicit Grafana dashboard links to the runbook and ensure we have a pager rota for the first 48 hours.
4) QA gating: perf suite must pass 95th percentile thresholds on staging and a dry-run with synthetic traffic must be completed by 6/25.

Question for product: is the fallback model (smaller-context variant) enabled by default for production? If so, document it in the runbook and notify Acme of the behavior.

Aditya

Subject: Re: Pre-launch thresholds, canary plan, and doc ownership for Runtime v2 activation — mutual action plan

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Summary & owners (please poke if anything incorrect):

- Docs: Lauren — migration FAQ and runbook. Drafts due 6/14 and 6/15 respectively; runbook review with Ops 6/18. (attachments: rollout_gate_template.docx)
- Enablement: Marissa — owns slide deck and training schedule. Training slots: Jun 26 morning, Jun 28 afternoon. Marissa will add Acme-specific scenarios. (attachment: enablement_deck_v1.pdf)
- Ops gating: Aditya — canary 10% x 4 hours; rollback triggers = 5xx > 0.5% or P99 >25% regression; reserve burst capacity decision by 6/14; QA dry-run by 6/25. (see canary-matrix.csv)
- Exceptions/Legal: Acme asked for a data-residency note. I'll loop in Legal if Acme needs a contractual addendum — Acme, can you confirm the exact residency requirement?

Next steps (mutual action items):
- Each owner to post drafts to the shared Drive folder by the dates above. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_prelaunch_docs
- Leadership update: I'll send a brief to leadership on 6/11 summarizing open blockers and procurement ask.
- If procurement is required for burst GPUs, ops to raise the request by 6/14.

Acme team — feel free to reply here with residency specifics and any additional rollback constraints you require before we finalize the go/no-go.

I'll assemble the mutual action plan doc and the HubSpot deal note once I have the confirmations.

Thanks — Karthik
